name: Conventional HTML reader with Gmail-oriented fallback behavior
selection: Security gates first; high-utility static rendering; Gmail-web nudge for low-priority extras; accessibility and language exceptions.

bounded.css-at-media: Only screen/all, min/max-width and Boolean combinations over message viewport; cap nesting. Device-width may alias viewport. No request-on-match.
bounded.css-background-clip: Clip to message surface, bound paint complexity, and preserve user-controlled readable view.
bounded.css-background-image: Resolve only to pre-authorized image capabilities; no arbitrary fetch from layout. CID and approved raster data first; user-approved HTTPS images through broker.
bounded.css-background: Resolve only to pre-authorized image capabilities; no arbitrary fetch from layout. CID and approved raster data first; user-approved HTTPS images through broker.
bounded.css-direction: Support actual message language direction. Keep envelope/security UI isolated; show canonical link targets; preserve logical copy/accessibility order.
bounded.css-display: Implement none, block, inline, inline-block and table roles together. Flex/grid values remain unsupported and do not pass @supports.
bounded.css-float: Support bounded ordinary left/right floats, no shape-outside, no escape beyond message. Verify termination/work budget.
bounded.css-height: Finite bounded dimensions; cap intrinsic/reflow work and decoded image sizes. Never affect application chrome.
bounded.css-list-style: Support marker type/position; ignore list image URLs initially; cap depth and counter arithmetic.
bounded.css-margin: Bound finite geometry. Negative margins remain within clipped message surface and cannot cover trusted UI.
bounded.css-max-height: Finite bounded dimensions; cap intrinsic/reflow work and decoded image sizes. Never affect application chrome.
bounded.css-min-width: Finite bounded dimensions; cap intrinsic/reflow work and decoded image sizes. Never affect application chrome.
bounded.css-opacity: Implement hidden semantics consistently in render/copy/accessibility; preserve a user-readable text view; no cross-message state.
bounded.css-outline: Trusted keyboard focus indicator cannot be suppressed; allow harmless message styling beneath it.
bounded.css-overflow: Support visible/hidden clipping; expose clipped content in reader text view. No nested scroll widgets initially.
bounded.css-pseudo-class-focus-visible: Trusted keyboard focus indicator cannot be suppressed; allow harmless message styling beneath it.
bounded.css-pseudo-class-focus: Trusted keyboard focus indicator cannot be suppressed; allow harmless message styling beneath it.
bounded.css-pseudo-class-hover: Only benign hover/active/focus styling on links; no forms, checkbox-driven apps, request-on-state or sender focus grabs.
bounded.css-selector-attribute: Message-only nonsecret attributes, bounded matching, no CSS-triggered network. Never expose app/authentication attributes to selectors.
bounded.css-text-decoration: Use local fonts and bounded shaping/layout; keep readable fallback, selection and accessibility; never parse text as markup.
bounded.css-text-indent: Bound finite geometry. Negative margins remain within clipped message surface and cannot cover trusted UI.
bounded.css-text-overflow: Support visible/hidden clipping; expose clipped content in reader text view. No nested scroll widgets initially.
bounded.css-unit-calc: Typed finite arithmetic; bound AST and steps; checked/rational geometry. Initially calc() with length/percentage add/subtract and literal scaling.
bounded.css-unit-vh: Resolve only against message viewport, not screen/application size; cap resulting geometry.
bounded.css-unit-vw: Resolve only against message viewport, not screen/application size; cap resulting geometry.
bounded.css-visibility: Implement hidden semantics consistently in render/copy/accessibility; preserve a user-readable text view; no cross-message state.
bounded.html-anchor-links: Local IDs resolve within message only; trusted action broker for external links; canonical destination display.
bounded.html-aria-describedby: Support scoped relationships and safe role subset; actual link target and trusted sender/security information remain client-owned.
bounded.html-aria-hidden: Support scoped relationships and safe role subset; actual link target and trusted sender/security information remain client-owned.
bounded.html-aria-label: Support scoped relationships and safe role subset; actual link target and trusted sender/security information remain client-owned.
bounded.html-aria-labelledby: Support scoped relationships and safe role subset; actual link target and trusted sender/security information remain client-owned.
bounded.html-background: Resolve only to pre-authorized image capabilities; no arbitrary fetch from layout. CID and approved raster data first; user-approved HTTPS images through broker.
bounded.html-bdi: Support actual message language direction. Keep envelope/security UI isolated; show canonical link targets; preserve logical copy/accessibility order.
bounded.html-comments: Ordinary HTML comment handling; render non-MSO/downlevel-revealed path, not Word/VML branch. Cap tokenizer work.
bounded.html-dir: Support actual message language direction. Keep envelope/security UI isolated; show canonical link targets; preserve logical copy/accessibility order.
bounded.html-doctype: Use a fixed documented email layout model; do not implement all browser quirks modes. Keep doctype token parsing safe.
bounded.html-hidden: Implement hidden semantics consistently in render/copy/accessibility; preserve a user-readable text view; no cross-message state.
bounded.html-img: CID/raster data and explicitly approved remote raster images through resource broker; no auto fetch, bounded decode and isolated MIME identities.
bounded.html-loading-attribute: Author eager/lazy never authorizes a fetch. Client chooses decode scheduling from already-approved resources.
bounded.html-mailto-links: User gesture only; compose draft, never send. Validate/strip controls and disallow dangerous headers/attachments and arbitrary OS handlers.
bounded.html-role: Support scoped relationships and safe role subset; actual link target and trusted sender/security information remain client-owned.
bounded.html-style: Scoped per-message cascade, one parser, bounded rules/selectors/declarations, correct !important and individual-declaration recovery.
bounded.html-table: Bound nodes, nesting, spans, grid dimensions and layout steps; preserve table semantics and reading order.
bounded.image-apng: Render a meaningful static first frame/poster; decoded-pixel, input-byte and work budgets. No ongoing animation in initial profile.
bounded.image-base64: Strict data:image raster allowlist and base64/percent decoding limits; no SVG/HTML/XML, no navigation or origin inheritance.
bounded.image-gif: Render a meaningful static first frame/poster; decoded-pixel, input-byte and work budgets. No ongoing animation in initial profile.
bounded.image-jpg: Rust/verified decoder where available; pixel/input/work budgets; ignore active metadata and external references. Separate attachment preview policy.
bounded.image-png: Rust/verified decoder where available; pixel/input/work budgets; ignore active metadata and external references. Separate attachment preview policy.
bounded.image-webp: Render a meaningful static first frame/poster; decoded-pixel, input-byte and work budgets. No ongoing animation in initial profile.

gates: Renderer performs no I/O; one external resource broker owns all capabilities.
Explicit load action for a fixed literal URL manifest; fetch scheduling independent of CSS matches and reader interactions.
Local font fallback only; reject @font-face, @import and external link stylesheets.
Separate typed documents for messages and MIME trust domains; no sender CSS over decrypted/plain parts, replies or trusted UI.
Width-only media queries; message viewport units; no history, device probing, @container, relational selectors or live widgets.
Clip all paint and hit tests to message surface; initial static positioning, no z-index overlays, filters, masks or transforms.
Bound parse/selector/layout/decoder steps and allocations, not merely recursion depth; visible fallback on budget exhaustion.
Static GIF/APNG/WebP frame with optional user-triggered external viewing. Do not claim full animation support.
Use ordinary non-MSO HTML; do not identify as Word or activate VML-only conditional branches.
foundations: Select alternatives explicitly. Never concatenate raw HTML across unrelated MIME or encrypted/signed boundaries. Bound transfer decoding, nesting and output.
Decode once with defined replacement behavior. Preserve logical text. Bound decoded size and normalize only where the relevant identifier spec requires it.
Handle ordinary malformed HTML and table repair. Use one canonical parse into a typed rendering tree. Ignore script/event/custom-element behavior.
Basic anchors and HTTPS link actions
Normal a/href support is essential but not separately scored by Can I Email. Canonical destination shown by trusted UI; user gesture only; no opener or automatic external handlers.
Text primitives: br, b, i, em, sup/sub, font, center
Preserve readable defaults and legacy presentation attributes; these common building blocks are not individually covered by the rubric.
Implement common named/hex colors, local font fallback and emphasis. Missing from the individual Can I Email property list. No sender-supplied font resources.
CSS tokenizer, cascade, specificity and inheritance
One parse/policy path, shorthand expansion and declaration-level recovery. Inline styles and embedded styles share rules. Evaluate !important correctly.
tr/td/th, rowspan/colspan, nested tables, presentational hints and intrinsic widths. A single table feature test does not specify the algorithm.
Per-message paint, style, hit-test and accessibility isolation
Sender content cannot style, cover, focus, label or hit-test trusted envelope/security controls or other messages. No cross-part CSS onto decrypted plaintext.
Layout cannot perform I/O. Parse URLs into resource capabilities; CID references resolve inside the correct MIME identity. No file, local-network or privileged-scheme access.
Remote raster image permission and fetching

Block by default. On explicit approval fetch a fixed bounded literal URL manifest independently of selector/layout state. HTTPS, no cookies/auth/referrer, validate DNS/IP and redirects at connection time, block local/private addresses.
Budgets for parsing, selectors, layout and decoding
Input limits alone do not bound quadratic layout. Explicit work counters, cancellation and finite geometry; fail visibly into a readable text/attachment view.
Plain-text alternative and readable text view
Expose available plain alternative and a client-owned readable HTML-text view. Neither should execute markup or inherit sender CSS.
Trusted link target, focus, copying and selection
Author styles cannot suppress trusted focus/destination UI or prevent copying. Define the relationship between visual, accessible and copied text.
Drop executable subtrees and active attributes. Preserve safe fallback text/links. Unknown at-rules including @container do not execute. No script, iframe, embed or foreignObject.
Initial profile uses a coherent light message canvas even in dark app UI. Later coordinated theme conversion; never blindly invert only foreground or background.
Reparse quoted material into fresh scope. Sender CSS never styles new user text or trusted headers. Preserve provenance and MIME trust boundaries.
Native document semantics, alt text, logical reading order, keyboard navigation, safe ARIA, local speech language. Do not drop this because aggregate usage is small.
